sections.Profile:
The "Playboy" pinball machine by Stern, released in January 2002, integrates the iconic Playboy brand with engaging pinball gameplay. Designed by George Gomez and Dwight Sullivan, this machine features artwork by Kevin O'Connor and animations by Mark Galvez. It includes several unique playfield elements such as an unfolding centerfold toy, a "Tease" screen, and a Peek-a-Boo beaded curtain, all enhancing its thematic appeal.
